identity_rule: wwi:<canonical_entity>:<source_id>; organizations include the customer/supplier role

twenty_company_csv.identity_rule: WWI External ID = canonical_id; unique in Twenty
twenty_company_csv.id_rule: leave Twenty Id blank on import; populate the real UUID only after REST readback
twenty_company_csv.domain_rule: normalize to lowercase IDNA host; if a host occurs more than once, leave Domain blank for every member of that group; otherwise emit https://<host>

twenty_people_csv.identity_rule: WWI External ID = canonical_id; unique in Twenty
twenty_people_csv.company_relation_rule: Company WWI External ID = related organization canonical_id; import after Companies and map to the Company relation using the Company's WWI External ID field
twenty_people_csv.unrelated_people: leave Company WWI External ID blank

notes: ERPNext Company is the operating entity and is never mapped from a WWI customer.
Target CSV files are mapping-stage artifacts. They are not evidence that records were loaded.
Target IDs stay blank and load_status stays pending until a supported target import and REST readback occurs.
Do not change Twenty's Company domain unique index; source identity is carried by WWI External ID.
